in_marathi.name: Gajapati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajapati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit words 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Pat' (ruler). This name is given to a boy, symbolizing strength, power, and royalty. In Hindu mythology, the elephant is considered a sacred animal and a symbol of power and wisdom.
